text:
Sam (Sales): Heads-up — ACME.ai wants a dedicated capacity commit for their POC. They’re asking for a baseline of ~150 A100-equivalent GPU-hours/month, plus autoscaling to ~450 during demo windows. They also want burst billing at a reduced multiplier. Can we do that for a 6-month POC?
Priya (SE): Re: capacity — technically fine to run mixed A100/H100 pool. We can set baseline pool to 150 units and autoscale to 450. Default burst multiplier is 2.0x; operationally we can tolerate down to 1.8x without kernel changes. Anything below that needs deal-desk approval and may affect prewarm SLA. Also customer asked about KV cache warm start and model pinning during demos.
Luca (Finance): Quick framing: standard commit price is $6.00/hr baseline in our rate card; burst billed at multiplier (2.0 by default). A 1.6x multiplier is a material concession — need ARR/duration to justify. What are their expected monthly net ARR for Dedicated?
Nora (Deal Desk): @Luca + @Sam — we need the estimated spend and contract length. For sub-$50k/mo commits we typically don't change burst multipliers. Exceptions possible for strategic POCs if sales provides upsell path and SOW. Please provide the customer timeline and SLAs they require.
Sam (Sales): Customer expects ~ $25k/month in POC commit (6 months). They’re asking for burst multiplier of 1.5 during demo weeks and a provisional credit if we breach baseline in first month. They also flagged the security questionnaire: KMS + audit logs are required.
Priya (SE): KMS + audit logs: Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS and audit logging (we already have the hooks). For hosted Dedicated we need legal + infra signoffs to enable customer key binding. Prewarm: recommend a scheduled prewarm before demos to reduce peak latency.
Luca (Finance): Given $25k/mo estimate: we can offer this structure to start the approval flow — commit 150 GPU-hr/mo @ $6.00/hr = ~$900/mo baseline charge (illustrative), autoscale up to 450, burst multiplier = 1.8x by default. Offer a one-time provisional credit of 20% of month1 invoice if demos force >baseline usage. Lowering multiplier to 1.6x requires deal-desk sign-off and should be conditional on a minimum 9-month extension or evidence of expansion.
Nora (Deal Desk): Proposed conditional approval: provisional POC credit 20% for month 1 (applied after invoice review), burst cap at 2x baseline for month 1 only, and 1.8x multiplier for remainder of POC. We’ll approve 1.6x only if Sales secures a written renewal option (3-month notice) or increases committed spend to $40k/mo. Need a short memo from Sales capturing upsell plan. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: provisioning-task created -> POC-cluster-reserve-1902345678. ETA: 48h for baseline pool. Autoscale policy will be staged behind canary.
Sam (Sales): OK — next actions: @Priya confirm KMS enablement steps and any infra blocking items by EOD; @Nora draft deal memo and conditional terms; @Luca produce pro forma (inc. provisional credit line). I’ll relay to ACME.ai and push for renewal language.
Priya (SE): Confirmed — KMS enablement is feasible for Dedicated; need signed SOW and KMS key ARN from customer. Will post config snippet to #eng-ops and tag infra.
Nora (Deal Desk): Drafting memo now, will post within 6 hours and request exec review if needed.
Luca (Finance): I'll prepare the pro forma and attach suggested billing schedule and credit notes.
Sam (Sales): Thanks team — I’ll hold customer expectations to these conditional terms and circle back after Nora posts the memo. :thumbsup:
